question: Who among the following was appointed as the Chairman and Managing Director of Telecommunications Consultants India Limited in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjeev Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shri Sanjeev Kumar, Director (Technical), MTNL has been appointed as the Chairman-cum-Managing Director of Telecommunications Consultants India Limited**__.

 __
 
• The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) has approved the appointment of Sanjeev Kumar.
 
• According to an order of the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT), he has been appointed to the post for a period of five years from the date of joining the post or till the age of superannuation or until further orders. , whichever is earlier.
 
• He is presently working as Director (Technical) in Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited (MTNL).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Telecommunications Consultants India Limited (TCIL):**

 
 
• It is a Miniratna PSU under the administrative control of the Department of Telecommunications, Ministry of Communications. TCIL, a premier telecommunication consultancy, and engineering company is making available its vast and varied telecom expertise to friendly developing countries.
 
• Founded in 1978
 
• Headquarters - New Delhi.
